revEp.title: Reversible EP / Cargo Delivery
revEp.subtitle: Predicted target uptake at this protocol: {pct}%
revEp.hint: Reversible electroporation opens transient pores that let cargo (dyes, drugs, siRNA, plasmids) into the cytoplasm without lysing the cell. Uptake peaks in the middle of the reversible-EP window (DR ~ 0.65-0.75); above DR 0.85 the cell lyses and productive delivery collapses.
revEp.cargoPiTip: Propidium iodide MW 668 Da; standard membrane-integrity stain. Crosses any reversible-EP pore quickly.
revEp.cargoSmallPepTip: Small peptide / oligonucleotide MW ~5 kDa; needs a permeabilization event but moderate cargo size.
revEp.cargoSiRnaTip: siRNA duplex MW ~13 kDa; classic gene-silencing cargo. Needs sustained permeabilization.
revEp.cargoMidPepTip: Mid-MW protein MW ~50 kDa (BSA-class). Half-uptake point in this model.
revEp.cargoIggTip: Antibody (IgG) MW ~150 kDa. Large cargo, sub-50% efficiency in the reversible window.
revEp.cargoPlasmidTip: Plasmid DNA (e.g. pUC, pET) MW ~3 MDa for a 5 kb plasmid. Productive uptake is hardest; nuclear delivery often the rate limit.
revEp.targetUptakeTip: Target uptake fraction Fraction of target cells predicted to take up cargo at the current operating point. Peaks near DR=0.675 in the middle of the reversible-EP window. Drops to zero below DR=0.50 (sub-threshold) and at/above DR=0.85 (lysis).
revEp.healthyUptakeTip: Healthy off-target uptake Fraction of healthy cells that would also be permeabilized. Lower is better. >5% suggests the protocol is leaking into healthy tissue and may need lower field or sharper selectivity.
revEp.resealTip: Predicted membrane reseal time Time for the EP-formed pores to close after the pulse train. Drives the cargo-loading window: cargo present in the medium during this interval gets in. Modelled per Rols & Teissié 1990 with temperature and pulse-count corrections.
revEp.chartTip: Uptake-vs-DR curve Bell-shape efficiency across the reversible-EP window. Solid red dot is your target operating point; smaller blue dot is the healthy off-target. Move sliders in the lab to walk along the curve.
revEp.caveat: Predictions calibrated against bulk uptake studies (Rols 1990, Pakhomov 2010, Yarmush 2014) and represent a population-averaged efficiency. Per-cell uptake is bimodal in real assays — this model reports the mean. Resealing time is empirical with ~30% inter-lab variability.
